boards.title: Your First Weekend at St. Joseph's University-New York, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-key first-weekend sequence centered on getting oriented to SJNY’s Brooklyn campus, its student-life resources and its Clinton Hill setting.

cards.title: Start at Burns Hall
cards.subtitle: Stop 1 — 245 Clinton Avenue
cards.notes: Begin with the campus map open and use Burns Hall as your reference point. Note the Clinton Avenue address before branching out to nearby buildings.
cards.short_summary: A practical first landmark for locating the Brooklyn campus.
cards.evidence_claim: SJNY’s Brooklyn Campus Map lists Burns Hall at 245 Clinton Avenue.
cards.source_title: Brooklyn Campus Map | St. Joseph's University, New York
cards.access_notes: Use the University’s campus map to plan the walk; building access may vary.

cards.title: Locate McEntegart Hall Library
cards.subtitle: Stop 2 — 222 Clinton Avenue
cards.notes: Find the library early, then save its location for a later study session. It is a useful anchor when you begin planning research-heavy coursework.
cards.short_summary: Identify the campus library before classes start.
cards.evidence_claim: SJNY’s Brooklyn Campus Map lists McEntegart Hall Library at 222 Clinton Avenue.
cards.source_title: Brooklyn Campus Map | St. Joseph's University, New York
cards.access_notes: Library access and service hours are not stated on the cited map page.

cards.title: Pause at Evodio’s Place
cards.subtitle: Stop 3 — campus dining and study break
cards.notes: Build in a meal or study break at Evodio’s Place. Use the pause to compare notes from your campus walk and decide which student-life office to visit next.
cards.short_summary: A campus dining location that also supports studying and conversation.
cards.evidence_claim: SJNY identifies Evodio’s Place as a place to study, eat, catch up on coursework, hang out or grab food to go.
cards.source_title: Student Life | Brooklyn Campus | St. Joseph's University, New York
cards.access_notes: Food purchases may be required; check current campus dining availability before visiting.

cards.title: Find the Student Life Suite in Tuohy Hall
cards.subtitle: Stop 4 — learn where to ask about activities
cards.notes: Walk to Tuohy Hall and note the Student Life Suite. It is the campus contact point named by the Activities Board for questions, ideas and getting involved.
cards.short_summary: Pin down the campus location connected with student activities.
cards.evidence_claim: SJNY’s Campus Activities Board directs students to the Student Life Suite in Tuohy Hall.
cards.source_title: Campus Activities Board (C.A.B.) | Brooklyn Campus | St. Joseph's University, New York
cards.access_notes: The Campus Activities Board page names the suite but does not state visitor hours.

cards.title: Watch for a C.A.B. on-campus event
cards.subtitle: Stop 5 — live entertainment and campus programming
cards.notes: Check the campus activities calendar or Student Life Suite for an on-campus C.A.B. program. Choose an event that fits your schedule and attend with a new classmate.
cards.short_summary: A route into live campus programming, from performers to interactive sessions.
cards.evidence_claim: SJNY says its Campus Activities Board provides live entertainment and that its on-campus events are free.
cards.source_title: Campus Activities Board (C.A.B.) | Brooklyn Campus | St. Joseph's University, New York
cards.access_notes: Availability depends on the current campus calendar; the cited page states on-campus C.A.B. events are free.

cards.title: Make The Hill Center a campus landmark
cards.subtitle: Stop 6 — 212 Vanderbilt Avenue
cards.notes: Walk over to The Hill Center and save it as a recognizable destination. During orientation, Brooklyn students have used this building for a campus scavenger hunt.
cards.short_summary: A Vanderbilt Avenue campus stop tied to orientation activity.
cards.evidence_claim: SJNY’s map lists The Hill Center at 212 Vanderbilt Avenue, and its 2023 orientation coverage says Brooklyn students completed a scavenger hunt there.
cards.source_title: New St. Joseph's Students Attend Orientation Programs | On Campus
cards.access_notes: Confirm facility access before entering; the cited orientation activity is historical.

cards.title: Spot The Molloy Theatre
cards.subtitle: Stop 7 — 265 Clinton Avenue
cards.notes: Add The Molloy Theatre to your personal campus map while walking Clinton Avenue. Knowing the venue location makes it easier to recognize future arts programming.
cards.short_summary: A named theatre destination on the Brooklyn campus.
cards.evidence_claim: SJNY’s Brooklyn Campus Map lists The Molloy Theatre at 265 Clinton Avenue.
cards.source_title: Brooklyn Campus Map | St. Joseph's University, New York
cards.access_notes: Performance schedules and public access are not stated on the cited map page.

cards.title: Continue to Founder’s Hall
cards.subtitle: Stop 8 — 232 Clinton Avenue
cards.notes: Continue the campus walk at Founder’s Hall and use the address to orient yourself along Clinton Avenue. Pair this stop with a quick review of the map’s remaining buildings.
cards.short_summary: One of the map-listed Clinton Avenue buildings to learn on day one.
cards.evidence_claim: SJNY’s Brooklyn Campus Map lists Founder’s Hall at 232 Clinton Avenue.
cards.source_title: Brooklyn Campus Map | St. Joseph's University, New York
cards.access_notes: Use as an exterior wayfinding stop unless you have confirmed building access.

cards.title: Walk to St. Angela Hall
cards.subtitle: Stop 9 — 263 Waverly Avenue
cards.notes: Turn toward Waverly Avenue to locate St. Angela Hall. This detour helps connect the Clinton Avenue cluster to another named campus building on the official map.
cards.short_summary: A Waverly Avenue stop that broadens a first campus walk.
cards.evidence_claim: SJNY’s Brooklyn Campus Map lists St. Angela Hall at 263 Waverly Avenue.
cards.source_title: Brooklyn Campus Map | St. Joseph's University, New York
cards.access_notes: Use as an exterior wayfinding stop unless you have confirmed building access.

cards.title: Finish at St. Joseph’s Hall
cards.subtitle: Stop 10 — 256 Clinton Avenue
cards.notes: Finish your loop at St. Joseph’s Hall, then revisit the map and name three buildings you can now find without navigation. It is a simple reset before the week begins.
cards.short_summary: Close the self-guided campus loop at a named Clinton Avenue building.
cards.evidence_claim: SJNY’s Brooklyn Campus Map lists St. Joseph’s Hall at 256 Clinton Avenue.
cards.source_title: Brooklyn Campus Map | St. Joseph's University, New York
cards.access_notes: Use as an exterior wayfinding stop unless you have confirmed building access.
